source: Slice 2 second pass — DBE_Value family + DB_Attribute layout + EXMAP dispatch from IDA decompilation

revisions.change: DBE_Value +8 i32 renamed from `type_or_subtype` to `unit_kcondm` (it is the KCONDM-encoded unit-of-measure code from uomlib, set by DB_Element::getAtt at 0x5933ea0 via *a5 = KCONDM(&unit). NOT a type discriminator.)
Added DB_Attribute structure layout with verified field offsets.
Added EXMAP dispatch table — the (type,size,ityp,isUDA) -> expType mapping used by DBE_Base::FromAttribute.
Added DBE_Base layout and DBE_Attribute (84 bytes) ctor info.
Recorded isUDA mechanism: hash > 0x171FAD39 (the base-27 dehash upper bound).

next_passes: Resolve DBE_Base::expType enum symbolic names (0..19) — search for switch tables / vftable arrays indexed by expType
Identify ityp special values 23 / 29 / 38 / 48 (all map to expType=3 in EXMAP)
Determine DBE_Value aux_field/aux_flag write sites (no caller observed yet)
Cross-validate with fixture attribute records (ATGTDF type column)

DBE_Value.evidence: Constructor sub_59CE1C0 (DBE_Value::DBE_Value(double, int)) decompile. Verified via DB_Element::getAtt (0x5933ea0) which writes *(double*)dbe_value = value and *((int*)dbe_value + 2) = KCONDM(unit).

fields.name: value_as_double
fields.note: Primary value slot. Integer/Boolean/Real are stored as f64 (or its byte pattern).

fields.name: unit_kcondm
fields.note: KCONDM-encoded unit-of-measure code from uomlib. Source: DB_Attribute::unit (offset +48). NOT a type discriminator (correction from Slice 2 first pass).

fields.name: aux_field
fields.note: Initialized to 0; purpose TBD (no writer observed in surveyed callers).

DBE_RealValue.evidence: Constructor sub_59C1EA0 (sized 0x28); subclasses DBE_Value. Wraps a real number tied to a DBE_Base ptr.

DBE_PositionValue.evidence: Constructor sub_5842EE0: this+0..15=OWORD zero (16 bytes); this+16..23=QWORD zero (8 bytes) → 24 bytes of f64 triple; this+28+: DB_Element::DB_Element placed

DBE_DirectionValue.evidence: Constructor sub_5842C50: this+0..15=OWORD zero; this+16..23=QWORD zero → 24 bytes of f64 triple; this+24+: DB_Element

DBE_OrientationValue.evidence: Constructor sub_5842E60: 4 OWORDs zero (64 bytes) + QWORD zero at +64 = 72 bytes. DB_Element placed at this+72.

fields.name: matrix_or_quaternion_3x3
fields.note: 9 × f64. Could be 3x3 rotation matrix or extended quaternion-like representation; precise interpretation pending evaluate() decompile.

DBE_StringValue.evidence: Constructor sub_59B7710: this+16=0, this+20=15 (capacity_for_SSO=15), this+0=0 (size_low_byte), this+24..28=0, this+36 word=0. Layout matches MSVC std::string (SSO buffer at front, size at +16, capacity at +20).

fields.name: sso_buffer_or_ptr
fields.note: MSVC small-string optimization: short strings stored inline; longer strings replace with heap pointer.

DBE_StringValue.confidence: medium (size derived from ctor zero-init pattern; need to confirm against MSVC std::basic_string ABI)

fields.name: kind
fields.note: Discriminator for DBE_Base subclasses; DBE_Attribute uses kind=106.

fields.name: expType
fields.note: DBE_Base::expType enum — output of EXMAP dispatch.

DBE_Attribute.evidence: Constructor 0x5866c60. DBE_Attribute(this, expType) — calls DBE_Base::DBE_Base(106, expType); stores DB_Attribute* at +12; vtable patched twice (DBE_AttributeClasses then DBE_Attribute).

DB_Attribute.evidence: Recovered from DB_Attribute::ityp (0x58d2630), DB_Attribute::type (0x58d5150), DB_Attribute::size (0x58d4e90), DB_Attribute::unit (0x58d5230), DB_Attribute::isUDA (0x58d25c0).
DB_Attribute.lazy_init: All field accessors check byte at +8; if 0, call vtable[5] (offset +20) populator before returning the cached value.

fields.name: hash
fields.note: Attribute hash. If > 0x171FAD39 (387951929) → isUDA. Same upper bound as base-27 PDMS_Hash::String dehash range.

fields.name: lazy_init_flag
fields.note: 0 → fields not yet populated; vtable[5] gets invoked on next access.

fields.name: type
fields.note: Primary EXMAP dispatch input. Observed values: 1 (Integer), 2 (Real), 3 (Bool), 4, 5 (Text), 6 (Enum), 7 (Position), 8 (?), 9 (Direction/Orientation?), 10, 11, 12.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: KCONDM unit-of-measure code (uomlib). Stored verbatim into DBE_Value +8 by DB_Element::getAtt.

fields.name: ityp
fields.note: Internal type code. Special values: 23, 29, 38, 48 → all map to expType=3 in EXMAP regardless of type.

EXMAP_dispatch.purpose: Maps (DB_Attribute::type, size, ityp, isUDA) -> DBE_Base::expType. Implemented by sub_51D368F, MTR-traced as `exprlib/EXMAP`.
EXMAP_dispatch.input_signature: (int* isUDA_neg, int* type, int* size, int* ityp, int* out_expType, int* out_err)

expType_enum.evidence: Recovered from DBE_Base::typeAsString (0x59b6d40), DBE_Base::toVarType (0x59b6c50), DBE_Base::equivalentArrayType (0x59b5850), DBE_Base::equivalentScalarType (0x59b5890).

members.name: INVALID
members.note: Sentinel: default returned by equivalentScalarType/equivalentArrayType for unknown inputs; toVarType returns empty string.

members.name: REAL
members.note: Stores both Integer and Real scalars as f64.

members.name: (unused)
members.note: Not emitted by EXMAP; not handled by typeAsString/toVarType.

members.name: (unused)
members.note: Not emitted by EXMAP; not handled by typeAsString/toVarType.

members.name: BOOLEAN_ARRAY
members.note: Identified via equivalentScalarType(11)=1; not in typeAsString/toVarType (returns 'unknown').

members.name: INT_ARRAY
members.note: INT_ARRAY pairs with REAL scalar(2) because Integer scalar shares the REAL slot.

members.name: (unnamed)
members.note: EXMAP emits this for DB_Attribute::type==10; not present in any of the surveyed dispatch tables. Semantics TBD.

members.name: (self-pair)
members.note: equivalentArrayType(18)=18 and equivalentScalarType(18)=18. Likely a wildcard/any-type sentinel used by polymorphic expressions.

DB_Attribute_type_semantics_CORRECTED.warning: Significant correction from e3d-attlib heuristic mapping. Old e3d-attlib::AttrDataType::from_code is WRONG for several type codes.
DB_Attribute_type_semantics_CORRECTED.implication_for_e3d_attlib_rewrite: AttrDataType::from_code must be re-derived from EXMAP+typeAsString rather than from a hardcoded 1-12 → name table. The Slice 1 inventory's note that 'algorithm direction is correct' applies to the hash/parser layer, NOT to the type code labels.

type_code_to_DBE_class_mapping.status: RESOLVED by Slice 2 second-and-third pass — dispatch is via DB_Attribute fields through EXMAP -> expType; expType enum is fully named (see expType_enum and DB_Attribute_type_semantics_CORRECTED above).
type_code_to_DBE_class_mapping.note: DBE_*Value subclass selection at the C++ runtime layer is by static type (template-specialized overloads of evaluate/getAtt/getPmlValue) rather than by a runtime switch — Position/Direction/Orientation each have dedicated DBE_*Value subclasses, while bool/int/real/ref/text all use the base DBE_Value with f64 slot + KCONDM unit code at offset +8.
